unsupported_claims.claim: The top-left diagram identifier denotes an evaluation/system diagram.
unsupported_claims.reconstruction_evidence: The reconstruction introduces a “Diagram identifier” component and says it “Identifies the depicted evaluation/system diagram,” based on the label “2026-07-28-eval-184200 · rag-ingestion-retrieval.”
unsupported_claims.why_unsupported: The brief does not describe an evaluation identifier or any system component with this responsibility. This is visual metadata rather than part of the software system.

verdict.strongest_transmitted_behavior: The strongest transmitted behavior is the primary governed serving path: arrivals carry ACLs through extraction, chunking, rate-limited embedding, and three-store version-consistent publication; user questions are rewritten, sent through hybrid vector/keyword retrieval, fused and reranked, filtered by user ACLs, and resolved to either an answer with citations or an explicit low-confidence abstention.
verdict.most_consequential_loss: The most consequential loss is the document-version update lifecycle: the reconstruction omits the unchanged-content bypass, changed-version supersession, and deletion of stale derived records. It also leaves publication repair/rollback unspecified, so engineers cannot determine how updates avoid duplicate or stale searchable records.
verdict.overall_summary: The board communicates the system's purpose, major components, primary end-to-end flow, permission boundary, consistent-publication gate, core failure destinations, low-confidence abstention, and the broad background rebuild mechanism. It is strong enough for an architecture discussion, but not an implementation plan. Several system-defining operational semantics are missing or only suggested: unchanged bypass, supersession and stale-record deletion, non-blocking batch quarantine, dead-letter payload and re-entry, repair or rollback of partial publication, feedback-to-ingestion prioritization, continued serving from the current generation during rebuild, and retention of the prior generation for rollback. There are no system-defining contradictions, and the main flow is reconstructable, but multiple important relationships require inference.
